title: AS2 classes P1: compilation pass (runClassPass) + fully-qualified names + interfaces; Ruffle-gated
description: Compile user .as classes into the published SWF and link them to symbols. Depends on P0 (asClasses in model). The AS2 compiler already exists at packages/core/src/as2/ (compileAS2 compiles ONE class source to AVM1 bytecode; handles class/extends/implements/interface, prototype chain, registerClass). The reuse template is runComponentPass in packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts (~1830-1924): compile class via compileAS2 -> encodeRawDoInitAction (definition) pushed BEFORE encodeDoInitAction registerClass binding. (1) New packages/swf/src/compiler/classes.ts runClassPass: collect referenced classes (all entries in doc.asClasses for v1 = simple/deterministic; closure-trim later), parse each, topologically order by extends (superclass DoInitAction before subclass), compile each to a DoInitAction body, merge into compile.ts exportEntries/doInitActionBodies exactly like the component pass (compile.ts ~155-157). runSymbolPass already emits registerClass(linkageId, className) for linked symbols (symbols.ts ~282-328) — ensure class-definition ordering precedes it. (2) COMPILER GAPS to fix (start here, Ruffle-first): FULLY-QUALIFIED class names — today tests use bare names (Animal); com.example.Foo must register as _global.com.example.Foo (nested object path). Write the Ruffle e2e for a dotted-name class FIRST; fix compileClassDecl (as2/compiler.ts ~2909) if it doesn't resolve. Also emit an empty constructor for INTERFACE decls so ActionImplementsOp works (compiler.ts ~735 currently no-ops). (3) import stays a resolution hint (no bytecode) — used by the pass to decide what to compile. ACCEPTANCE = Ruffle e2e (per CLAUDE.md byte tests are necessary-not-sufficient): a .as class linked to a library MovieClip, attachMovie at runtime, call a method, assert trace() in the Output panel (trace-output.spec.ts is the template). VERIFY: build + core/swf tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable) + the new Ruffle e2e passes. Conflict hotspots: compile.ts, as2/compiler.ts. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry.
